name: TailTwins
mechanic: Your trade must match the pool's live price on its last digit - a moving target.
plain: The pool has a live price that changes a little with every trade. Your swap only goes through if its last digit matches the price's last digit. Since each trade moves the price, the target keeps moving - you're aiming at a number that won't hold still.
rules: A swap clears only if its last digit matches the pool price's last digit.
Each trade moves the price, so the target keeps shifting.
You're aiming at a number that won't hold still.
